quantity_calculation.entry: Bank17 ACAF followed by ADDB numeric transforms, normal AA98 outgoing result
quantity_calculation.scope: Executable unsigned quantity calculation from explicit ACAF inputs. inputs.comparison70E3: u8:70E3 at ACAF; semantic source is caller-dependent
inputs.comparison70E4: u8:70E4 at ACAF; semantic source is caller-dependent
inputs.fallbackRandomByte: u8:37 before EC9D, used only when comparisonAdjusted <= floor(defense/2)
inputs.randomByte: u8:return of the current D02E call inside EC9D (not previous37, not the multiplied factor)
inputs.shield: u8:724E[selected target]; nonzero enables integer divide5

quantity_calculation.input_policy: All inputs are required and validated, including inactive-branch inputs. Browser supplies its own current action state and random choices; no emulator capture dependency and no sample defaults. Field labels70E3/70E4 intentionally avoid assigning universal actor/target meanings to caller-dependent operands.
quantity_calculation.output: Named intermediate values and final unsigned16 quantity; displayed amount is not clamped to target HP. Text selection/identity continue to belong to the separate invocation contract.
operations: intermediate = comparisonAdjusted-floor(defense/2) if strictly positive, else fallbackRandomByte&3
randomFactor=floor(randomByte*102/256); subtract D654(intermediate,randomFactor) when <51, else add D654(intermediate,randomFactor-51); wrap16
kind04/22: tier0 unchanged, tier3 double wrap16, other tier1..12 use ROM numerator and D654
7206 bit7 halves rounded down, then nonzero724E divides by5 rounded down
quantity_calculation.fraction_warning: D654 drops carry from high-word addition before each shift. floor(value*factor/256) holds for value<=32767; larger inputs require the executable instruction algorithm. Counterexample65535*255 helper255 vs mathematical65279.

executable.integration: Reference semantics for the consumer to integrate. Publication does not install a browser evaluator or request dynamic eval.

quantity_calculation.post_calculation_preservation: ADDB health/death/reward writes do not writeC0/C1 after numeric transforms. AECD only callsA65A (710C queue marker) and tailFE85/FEDF (0441 flag bit); their bytes are probed. HP clamping is therefore not quantity clamping.
quantity_calculation.observer_label_caution: The supplementary trace names target_level/actor_level are acquisition labels for raw70E3/70E4 only. Their semantic roles depend on the preparation caller; this contract does not certify universal target/actor level fields.

command.width_rule: (format & 0F)+1; original format01 reads C0/C1 into D7/D8

required_provenance.requirement: The source must be the current numeric insertion of this selected target result after ADDB returns. Identity labels must be supplied by the executing runtime, not reconstructed from an item ID or copied from an old sample.

settlement_order.step: bind target context; target FF/linked/avoidance branches may bypass normal quantity path
execute current70EE preparation script, including its target-dependent/random calculation
call ADDB for additional target settlement; kinds04/22 can scale,7206 bit7 halves, nonzero724E uses divide5 path
test settled C0/C1: zero retains the previously selected record (normally017, but185 in the CC=B9 special branch); positive<=1000 selects016; greater1000 selects193
AB92->A734->F5FC executes selected text; read the quantity when its numeric insertion runs

final_quantity.missing: unavailable without matching current execution identity, phase, source and command-time RAM; do not use profile preparation, an intermediate register value or previous invocation
final_quantity.zero: zero is an unsigned value, not a missing sentinel; the ordinary non-B9 path keeps017 when zero; the B9 special path keeps185 and is outside this numeric-record contract
final_quantity.not_a_formula: This is a final command-time read contract, not a simulator. It does not predict a result from item/monster IDs or certify a full battle-item sequence.
